name: EXM_ENTERTAINMENT_POLICIES
description: This table contains all data related to a given entertainment policy.

columns.name: ENTERTAINMENT_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of entertainment expense policy.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_NAME
columns.description: Name of entertainment expense policy.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of entertainment expense policy.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of entertainment expense policy, whether Draft, Valid, Invalid, or Active. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: ENABLED_RATE_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether entertainment expense policy rate limits are enforced.

columns.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether entertainment expense policy limits are enforced by each submitted instance of entertainment expense item.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether daily amount limit of entertainment expenses is enforced. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: YEARLY_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether entertainment expense policy limits are enforced by maximum permitted annual amount. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: PERIOD_MONTH
columns.description: Starting month from which entertainment expense policy annual rate limit is counted. Values are from lookup MONTH.

columns.name: PERIOD_DAY
columns.description: Start date from which entertainment expense policy annual rate limit is counted. Values are from lookup DAY.

columns.name: CURRENCY_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Entertainment expense policy defined for a single currency or for multiple currencies. Values are from lookup EXM_CURRENCY_OPTION.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for entertainment expense policy defined for single currency.

columns.name: ENABLED_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether entertainment expense rates vary, based on employee role.

columns.name: POLICY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role type that determines entertainment expense policy rate, such as Job, Grade, or Position. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_ROLE.

columns.name: ATTENDEE_TYPES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether attendee types are used as rate determinant. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: POLICY_ENFORCEMENT_CODE
columns.description: Type of entertainment expense policy enforcement applied. Values are from lookup ORA_EXM_ENTERT_PO_ENFORCEM.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employees are warned when they submit expenses that exceed defined entertainment expense policy rate limit.

columns.name: WARNING_TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage that, when added to entertainment expense policy amount limit, defines maximum allowable limit, resulting in policy warning violation.

columns.name: DISP_WARNING_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether entertainment expense policy warning is displayed to user.

columns.name: PREVENT_SUBMISSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether expense report submission is prevented if entertainment expense policy violation occurs.

columns.name: ERROR_TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage that, when added to entertainment expense policy amount limit, defines maximum allowable limit, resulting in prevention of expense report submission.

columns.name: INDIVID_ATTENDEE_AMT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employee is required to enter amount for individual event attendees.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ATTENDEE_INFO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employee attendee-related fields display during entertainment expense entry. Examples of employee attendee-related fields include Employee Name and Title.

columns.name: EMPL_REQ_AS_ATTENDEE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether user is required to enter at least one employee name as attendee when user creates attendee in expense entry.

columns.name: NON_EMPL_ATTENDEE_INFO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether nonemployee attendee-related fields display during entertainment expense entry. Examples of nonemployee attendee-related fields include Name, Employer, and Address.

columns.name: EMP_ATTENDEE_AMT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether employee attendee amount is required, optional, or hidden. Values are from look up EXM_FIELD_BEHAVIOUR.

columns.name: NONEMP_ATTENDEE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether nonemployee attendee type is required, optional, or hidden. Values are from look up EXM_FIELD_BEHAVIOUR.

columns.name: NONEMP_ATTENDEE_AMT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether nonemployee attendee amount is required, optional, or hidden. Values are from look up EXM_FIELD_BEHAVIOUR.

columns.name: NONEMP_ATTENDEE_ADDRS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether nonemployee employer address is required, optional, or hidden. Values are from look up EXM_FIELD_BEHAVIOUR.

columns.name: NONEMP_JOB_TITLE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether nonemployee job title is required, optional, or hidden. Values are from look up EXM_FIELD_BEHAVIOUR.

columns.name: RATE_LIMIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether policy rate limit is defined per expense type or per attendee. Values are from look up ORA_EXM_LIMIT_TYPE.

columns.name: NONEMP_CREATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether user can create nonemployee. Values are from look up EXM_YES_NO.

columns.name: EMPLOYER_CREATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether user can create nonemployee employer. Values are from look up EXM_YES_NO.

columns.name: NONEMP_REQUIRED_ATTENDEE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether user is required to enter at least one nonemployee as attendee. Values are from look up EXM_YES_NO.

columns.name: EMP_RATE_DETERMINANT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employee is used as the entertainment policy rate determinant. Values are from look up EXM_YES_NO.

columns.name: NONEMP_RATE_DETERMINANT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether nonemployee is used as the entertainment policy rate determinant. Values are from look up EXM_YES_NO.

columns.name: NUM_OF_ATTENDEES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether capturing number of attendees is mandatory.

columns.name: NUM_OF_ATTENDEES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount above which capturing number of attendees is mandatory.

columns.name: NUM_OF_ATTENDEES_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the amount above which capturing number of attendees is mandatory.
